source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesMinecraft: ULTIMATE COLLECTIONReleases 10/27/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Minecraft: ULTIMATE COLLECTIONFantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingCreate, explore and survive alone or with friends CREATE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play! Jump in with the ULTIMATE COLLECTION including: Five add-ons: Celebration Food, Rescue Dogs, Plenty O’ Blocks, Decocraft, and Weapons + Tools; five exclusive Character Creator items; and 1000 Minecoins*. VIBRANT VISUALS**Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals** enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER***Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS** - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE Nintendo Switch™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Included Minecoins and any Minecoins purchased in Minecraft on a Nintendo device must be used in the Nintendo ecosystem. **Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. ***Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account. Online multiplayer functionality requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately).Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.MinecraftGamesMINECRAFT: ULTIMATE COLLECTION DLCGamesPublisher notification(s):Already own a digital version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™? Get a digital Minecraft Standard Edition for Nintendo Switch™ 2 for free or pre-order the Deluxe Collection or Ultimate Collection at a discount by January 31, 2027.About this itemSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)Local wireless (2-8)Online (2-8)Nintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTingus Goose is a delightfully absurd idle game where you plant seeds in patients, bounce babies for profit, and ascend through surreal worlds toward riches. Witness the miracle of life in this accurate goose-growing simulator. Pop your seed into a patient's conveniently empty torso, add water, and watch a towering goose-tree burst with fresh Babies (nature's most renewable source of cash). OPTIMISE As newborn Babies tumble down the tree, they will bounce off Blossoms to generate cash. Make sure to place your Blossoms strategically to boost your yield. Next, slot Specimens to build runaway synergies that supercharge every Baby bounce. PROGRESS Treat new Patients and unlock surreal Worlds, each with its own unique twists and challenges. Unlock new Blossoms and Specimens to incorporate into your build to push further. Mature Content Description The developers describe the content like this: The game contains surreal themes of growth and reproduction. A goose character evolves by merging with different creatures, resulting in unusual body transformations. The story also includes symbolic references to mating between geese.
